FILES = "abcdefgh"
RANKS = "12345678"
INITIAL = "rnbqkbnr/pppppppp/8/8/8/8/PPPPPPPP/RNBQKBNR w KQkq - 0 1"
ROOK = [[0, 1], [0, -1], [-1, 0], [1, 0]].freeze
BISHOP = [[1, 1], [-1, 1], [1, -1], [-1, -1]].freeze
KING = (ROOK + BISHOP).freeze
KNIGHT = [[1, 2], [2, 1], [2, -1], [1, -2], [-1, -2], [-2, -1], [-2, 1], [-1, 2]].freeze
RULES = {
  "K" => [4, 7, 6, 5, [5, 6]],
  "Q" => [4, 0, 2, 3, [1, 2, 3]],
  "k" => [60, 63, 62, 61, [61, 62]],
  "q" => [60, 56, 58, 59, [57, 58, 59]]
}.freeze
Move = Struct.new(:source, :target, :promotion)
Record = Struct.new(:san, :uci, :captured)
def opposite(c) = c == "w" ? "b" : "w"
def color(p) = p == p.upcase ? "w" : "b"
def colored(p, c) = c == "w" ? p : p.downcase
def step(c) = c == "w" ? 8 : -8
def square(s) = /\A[a-h][1-8]\z/.match?(s) ? FILES.index(s[0]) + 8 * RANKS.index(s[1]) : -1
def name(s) = FILES[s % 8] + RANKS[s / 8]
def number(s, lo, hi) = /\A(?:0|[1-9][0-9]*)\z/.match?(s) && (lo..hi).cover?(s.to_i) ? s.to_i : -1
def shift(s, dx, dy)
  x = s % 8 + dx
  y = s / 8 + dy
  (0...8).cover?(x) && (0...8).cover?(y) ? 8 * y + x : -1
end

def targets(board, s)
  p = board[s]
  kind = p.upcase
  if %w[P N K].include?(kind)
    directions = kind == "P" ? [[-1, color(p) == "w" ? 1 : -1], [1, color(p) == "w" ? 1 : -1]] : kind == "N" ? KNIGHT : KING
    return directions.map { |dx, dy| shift(s, dx, dy) }.select { |t| t >= 0 }
  end

  directions = kind == "Q" ? KING : kind == "R" ? ROOK : BISHOP
  result = []
  directions.each do |dx, dy|
    t = shift(s, dx, dy)
    while t >= 0
      result << t
      break if board[t] != "."
      t = shift(t, dx, dy)
    end
  end

  result
end

def attackers(board, t, c) = (0...64).select { |s|
  board[s] != "." && color(board[s]) == c && targets(board, s).include?(t)
}

class Position
  attr_reader :board, :side, :rights, :ep, :half, :full
  def initialize(board, side, rights, ep, half, full)
    @board, @side, @rights, @ep, @half, @full = board, side, rights, ep, half, full
    @legal = nil
  end

  def check(c = @side) = !attackers(@board, @board.index(colored("K", c)), opposite(c)).empty?
  def castle(m) = @board[m.source].upcase == "K" && (m.target - m.source).abs == 2
  def enpassant(m) = @board[m.source].upcase == "P" && m.source % 8 != m.target % 8 && @board[m.target] == "."
  def capture(m) = @board[m.target] != "." || enpassant(m)
  def captured(m) = @board[m.target] != "." ? @board[m.target].downcase : enpassant(m) ? "p" : "-"
  def play(m)
    b = @board.dup
    piece = b[m.source]
    kind = piece.upcase
    b[m.target - step(@side)] = "." if enpassant(m)
    if castle(m)
      r = RULES[colored(m.target > m.source ? "K" : "Q", @side)]
      b[r[3]] = b[r[1]]
      b[r[1]] = "."
    end

    b[m.target] = m.promotion.empty? ? piece : colored(m.promotion, @side)
    b[m.source] = "."
    rights = @rights
      .chars
      .select { |r| (kind != "K" || color(r) != @side) && ![m.source, m.target].include?(RULES[r][1]) }
      .join
    Position.new(
      b,
      opposite(@side),
      rights,
      kind == "P" && (m.target - m.source).abs == 16 ? (m.source + m.target) / 2 : -1,
      kind == "P" || capture(m) ? 0 : @half + 1,
      @full + (@side == "b" ? 1 : 0)
    )
  end

  def pseudo
    result = []
    @board.each_with_index do |piece, s|
      next if piece == "." || color(piece) != @side
      pawn = piece.upcase == "P"
      a = []
      if pawn
        d = step(@side)
        if @board[s + d] == "."
          a << s + d
          a << s + 2 * d if s / 8 == (@side == "w" ? 1 : 6) && @board[s + 2 * d] == "."
        end

        a += targets(@board, s).select { |t| (@board[t] != "." && color(@board[t]) != @side) || t == @ep }
      else
        a = targets(@board, s).select { |t| @board[t] == "." || color(@board[t]) != @side }
      end

      a.each { |t|
        (pawn && t / 8 == (@side == "w" ? 7 : 0) ? %w[Q R B N] : [""]).each { |p| result << Move.new(s, t, p) }
      }
    end

    result
  end

  def castling_move(kingside)
    r = RULES[colored(kingside ? "K" : "Q", @side)]
    Move.new(r[0], r[2], "")
  end

  def castling_problem(kingside)
    right = colored(kingside ? "K" : "Q", @side)
    r = RULES[right]
    return "no castling right" unless @rights.include?(right)
    return "path blocked" if r[4].any? { |s| @board[s] != "." }
    return "in check" if check
    return "through check" unless attackers(@board, r[3], opposite(@side)).empty?
    return "into check" if play(castling_move(kingside)).check(@side)
    nil
  end

  def legal
    @legal ||= begin
      a = pseudo.select { |m| !play(m).check(@side) }
      [true, false].each { |k| a << castling_move(k) unless castling_problem(k) }
      a
    end
  end

  def mark(m)
    q = play(m)
    q.check ? (q.legal.empty? ? "#" : "+") : ""
  end

  def disambiguation(m)
    others = legal.select { |x|
      !castle(x) && x.target == m.target && x.source != m.source && @board[x.source] == @board[m.source]
    }
    return "" if others.empty?
    return FILES[m.source % 8] if others.all? { |x| x.source % 8 != m.source % 8 }
    return RANKS[m.source / 8] if others.all? { |x| x.source / 8 != m.source / 8 }
    name(m.source)
  end

  def san(m)
    kind = @board[m.source].upcase
    text = if castle(m)
      m.target > m.source ? "O-O" : "O-O-O"
    elsif kind == "P"
      (capture(m) ? FILES[m.source % 8] + "x" : "") + name(m.target) + (m.promotion.empty? ? "" : "=" + m.promotion)
    else
      kind + disambiguation(m) + (capture(m) ? "x" : "") + name(m.target)
    end

    text + mark(m)
  end

  def key = [@board, @side, @rights, (@ep >= 0 && legal.any? { |m| enpassant(m) } ? @ep : -1)]
  def state = check ? (legal.empty? ? "checkmate" : "check") : (legal.empty? ? "stalemate" : "normal")
  def insufficient
    a = (0...64).select { |s| @board[s] != "." && @board[s].upcase != "K" }
    return false if a.any? { |s| "PRQ".include?(@board[s].upcase) }
    a.size <= 1 || a.all? { |s| @board[s].upcase == "B" } && a.map { |s| (s % 8 + s / 8) % 2 }.uniq.size == 1
  end

  def pins
    king = @board.index(colored("K", @side))
    found = []
    KING.each do |dx, dy|
      first = -1
      t = shift(king, dx, dy)
      while t >= 0
        p = @board[t]
        if p != "."
          if first < 0
            break if color(p) != @side
            first = t
          else
            found << [first, t] if color(p) != @side && ("Q" + (dx == 0 || dy == 0 ? "R" : "B")).include?(p.upcase)
            break
          end
        end

        t = shift(t, dx, dy)
      end
    end

    found.sort
  end

  def fen
    rows = 7.downto(0).map { |r| @board[r * 8, 8].join.gsub(/\.+/) { |run| run.size.to_s } }
    [rows.join("/"), @side, @rights.empty? ? "-" : @rights, @ep < 0 ? "-" : name(@ep), @half, @full].join(" ")
  end
end

def parse_fen(a)
  raise "fields" unless a.size == 6
  ranks = a[0].split("/", -1)
  raise "placement" unless ranks.size == 8
  board = Array.new(64, ".")
  ranks.each_with_index do |row, i|
    f = 0
    digit = false
    row.each_char do |c|
      if "12345678".include?(c)
        raise "placement" if digit
        f += c.to_i
        digit = true
      else
        raise "placement" unless "KQRBNPkqrbnp".include?(c) && f < 8
        board[(7 - i) * 8 + f] = c
        f += 1
        digit = false
      end
    end

    raise "placement" unless f == 8
  end

  raise "kings" unless board.count("K") == 1 && board.count("k") == 1
  raise "pawns" if (board[0, 8] + board[56, 8]).any? { |p| %w[P p].include?(p) }
  side = a[1]
  raise "side" unless %w[w b].include?(side)
  raise "castling" unless a[2] == "-" || /\A(?=.)K?Q?k?q?\z/.match?(a[2])
  rights = a[2] == "-" ? "" : a[2]
  rights.each_char { |r|
    rule = RULES[r]
    raise "castling" unless board[rule[0]] == colored("K", color(r)) && board[rule[1]] == colored("R", color(r))
  }
  ep = -1
  if a[3] != "-"
    ep = square(a[3])
    d = step(side)
    unless ep >= 0 &&
        ep /
        8 == (side == "w" ? 5 : 2) &&
        board[ep] == "." &&
        board[ep + d] == "." &&
        board[ep - d] == colored("P", opposite(side))
      raise "en passant"
    end
  end

  half = number(a[4], 0, 999)
  full = number(a[5], 1, 999)
  raise "clocks" if half < 0 || full < 0 || (ep >= 0 && half != 0)
  p = Position.new(board, side, rights, ep, half, full)
  raise "check" if p.check(opposite(side))
  p
end

def read_san(pos, text)
  mark = %w[+ #].include?(text[-1]) ? text[-1] : ""
  body = mark.empty? ? text : text[0...-1]
  castling = %w[O-O O-O-O].include?(body)
  promotion = ""
  target = -1
  capture = false
  kind = "P"
  file = ""
  rank = ""
  unless castling
    if body.size >= 2 && body[-2] == "="
      promotion = body[-1]
      raise "syntax" unless "QRBN".include?(promotion)
      body = body[0...-2]
    end

    raise "syntax" if body.size < 2
    target = square(body[-2, 2])
    raise "syntax" if target < 0
    body = body[0...-2]
    capture = body.end_with?("x")
    body = body[0...-1] if capture
    if !body.empty? && "KQRBN".include?(body[0])
      kind = body[0]
      hints = /\A([a-h]?)([1-8]?)\z/.match(body[1..])
      raise "syntax" unless hints && promotion.empty?
      file = hints[1]
      rank = hints[2]
    else
      raise "syntax" unless (capture ? /\A[a-h]\z/ : /\A\z/).match?(body)
      file = body
    end
  end

  legal = pos.legal
  raise "game over" if legal.empty?
  if castling
    kingside = body == "O-O"
    problem = pos.castling_problem(kingside)
    raise problem if problem
    move = pos.castling_move(kingside)
  else
    matches = -> (m) {
      pos.board[m.source].upcase == kind &&
        m.target == target &&
        !pos.castle(m) &&
        (file.empty? || FILES[m.source % 8] == file) &&
        (rank.empty? || RANKS[m.source / 8] == rank) &&
        (kind != "P" || (m.source % 8 != m.target % 8) == capture)
    }
    candidates = legal.select(&matches)
    raise pos.pseudo.any?(&matches) ? "leaves king in check" : "no such move" if candidates.empty?
    raise "ambiguous" if candidates.map(&:source).uniq.size > 1
    move = candidates[0]
    raise "capture mark" if pos.capture(move) != capture
    raise "missing promotion" if !move.promotion.empty? && promotion.empty?
    raise "invalid promotion" if !promotion.empty? && move.promotion.empty?
    raise "disambiguation" if kind != "P" && file + rank != pos.disambiguation(move)
    move = Move.new(move.source, move.target, promotion)
  end

  raise "check mark" if pos.mark(move) != mark
  move
end

def read_uci(pos, text)
  raise "syntax" unless /\A[a-h][1-8][a-h][1-8][qrbn]?\z/.match?(text)
  s = square(text[0, 2])
  t = square(text[2, 2])
  promotion = text[4..].upcase
  legal = pos.legal
  raise "game over" if legal.empty?
  raise "no piece" if pos.board[s] == "." || color(pos.board[s]) != pos.side
  move = legal.find { |m| m.source == s && m.target == t }
  raise pos.pseudo.any? { |m| m.source == s && m.target == t } ? "leaves king in check" : "no such move" unless move
  raise "missing promotion" if !move.promotion.empty? && promotion.empty?
  raise "invalid promotion" if !promotion.empty? && move.promotion.empty?
  Move.new(s, t, promotion)
end

def perft(p, d, stats = nil)
  return 1 if d == 0
  p.legal.sum do |m|
    q = p.play(m)
    n = perft(q, d - 1, stats)
    if d == 1 && stats
      stats[0] += 1
      stats[1] += 1 if p.capture(m)
      stats[2] += 1 if p.enpassant(m)
      stats[3] += 1 if p.castle(m)
      stats[4] += 1 unless m.promotion.empty?
      if q.check
        stats[5] += 1
        stats[6] += 1 if q.legal.empty?
      end
    end

    n
  end
end

class Game
  attr_reader :positions, :records, :loaded
  def initialize(start = parse_fen(INITIAL.split(" ")), loaded = false) = (
    @positions = [start]
    @records = []
    @loaded = loaded
  )
  def current = @positions[-1]
  def play(m)
    p = current
    @records << Record.new(p.san(m), name(m.source) + name(m.target) + m.promotion.downcase, p.captured(m))
    @positions << p.play(m)
  end

  def repetition = @positions.count { |p| p.key == current.key }
  def draws
    a = []
    a << "fifty" if current.half >= 100
    a << "threefold" if repetition >= 3
    a << "insufficient" if current.insufficient
    a
  end

  def result = current.state == "checkmate" ? (current.side == "b" ? "1-0" : "0-1") : current.state == "stalemate" ||
    !draws.empty? ? "1/2-1/2" : "*"
end

class Session
  def initialize = (@game = Game.new)
  def execute(line)
    cmd, *a = line.split(" ")
    commands = %w[NEW LOAD FEN BOARD MOVE UCI LEGAL STATUS UNDO PERFT DIVIDE ATTACKS PINS HISTORY PGN]
    unless commands.include?(cmd)
      puts("ERROR unknown command")
      return
    end

    bad = %w[NEW FEN BOARD STATUS PINS HISTORY PGN].include?(cmd) && !a.empty? || %w[MOVE UCI].include?(cmd) && a.empty?
    bad = a.size > 1 || (a.size == 1 && square(a[0]) < 0) if cmd == "LEGAL"
    bad = a.size != 1 || (a.size == 1 && square(a[0]) < 0) if cmd == "ATTACKS"
    n = -1
    if %w[UNDO PERFT DIVIDE].include?(cmd)
      n = a.size == 1 ? number(a[0], 1, cmd == "UNDO" ? 9999 : 3) : -1
      bad = n < 0
    end

    if bad
      puts("ERROR bad arguments")
      return
    end

    p = @game.current
    case cmd
    when "NEW"
      @game = Game.new
      puts("OK")
    when "LOAD"
      begin
        q = parse_fen(a)
        @game = Game.new(q, true)
        puts("OK")
      rescue RuntimeError => e
        puts("ERROR bad fen (#{e.message})")
      end

    when "FEN"
      puts(p.fen)
    when "BOARD"
      7.downto(0) { |r| puts(([r + 1] + p.board[r * 8, 8]).join(" ")) }
      puts("  a b c d e f g h")
    when "MOVE", "UCI"
      played = []
      failure = nil
      a.each_with_index do |text, i|
        begin
          m = cmd == "MOVE" ? read_san(@game.current, text) : read_uci(@game.current, text)
          @game.play(m)
          played << @game.records[-1].san
        rescue RuntimeError => e
          failure = "ILLEGAL move #{i + 1}: #{text} (#{e.message})"
          break
        end
      end

      puts("san " + played.join(" ")) if cmd == "UCI" && !played.empty?
      if failure
        puts(failure)
      elsif cmd == "MOVE"
        puts("OK")
      end

    when "LEGAL"
      from = a.empty? ? -1 : square(a[0])
      list = p.legal.select { |m| from < 0 || m.source == from }.map { |m| p.san(m) }.sort
      puts((["legal", list.size] + list).join(" "))
    when "STATUS"
      puts((["status", p.side == "w" ? "white" : "black", p.state, "rep", @game.repetition] + @game.draws).join(" "))
    when "UNDO"
      if n > @game.records.size
        puts("ERROR cannot undo")
      else
        @game.records.slice!(-n, n)
        @game.positions.slice!(-n, n)
        puts("OK")
      end

    when "PERFT"
      stats = Array.new(7, 0)
      perft(p, n, stats)
      puts(
        (["perft", n] +
          %w[nodes captures ep castles promotions checks mates].each_with_index.flat_map { |f, i| [f, stats[i]] })
          .join(" ")
      )
    when "DIVIDE"
      rows = p.legal.map { |m| [p.san(m), perft(p.play(m), n - 1)] }.sort_by(&:first)
      rows.each { |r| puts(r.join(" ")) }
      puts("total #{rows.sum(&:last)}")
    when "ATTACKS"
      t = square(a[0])
      white = attackers(p.board, t, "w")
      black = attackers(p.board, t, "b")
      puts(
        (["attacks", a[0], "white", white.size] +
          white.map { |s| name(s) } +
          ["black", black.size] +
          black.map { |s| name(s) })
          .join(" ")
      )
    when "PINS"
      pins = p.pins
      puts((["pins", pins.size] + pins.map { |s, t| name(s) + "-" + name(t) }).join(" "))
    when "HISTORY"
      puts("history #{@game.records.size}")
      @game.records.each_with_index { |r, i| puts("#{i + 1} #{r.uci} #{r.san} #{r.captured}") }
    when "PGN"
      result = @game.result
      puts("[Result \"#{result}\"]")
      if @game.loaded
        puts("[SetUp \"1\"]")
        puts("[FEN \"#{@game.positions[0].fen}\"]")
      end

      words = []
      @game.records.each_with_index { |r, i|
        q = @game.positions[i]
        words << "#{q.full}." if q.side == "w"
        words << "#{q.full}..." if q.side == "b" && i == 0
        words << r.san
      }
      puts((words + [result]).join(" "))
    end
  end
end

lines = STDIN.each_line.map(&:chomp)
session = Session.new
lines.drop(1).first(lines[0].to_i).each { |line| session.execute(line) }
